item.title: Lyse Doucet: Under fragile ceasefire, Iranians wonder if US deal can be done
item.summary: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Iran as diplomatic efforts to avoid a return to war intensify.

item.title: Israeli triple-tap strike kills three paramedics in Lebanon, officials say
item.summary: Lebanon's government condemns as a "flagrant crime" the killing of the paramedics, one of whom featured in a BBC report.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah continue attacks after Israel-Lebanon talks in US
item.summary: Israel strikes hit southern Lebanon and Hezbollah fires rockets at Israel, a day after rare direct negotiations.

item.title: Sri Lanka repatriates 238 Iranian sailors stranded after US torpedo attack
item.summary: The survivors of the US attack on Iranian vessel Iris Dena, which claimed the lives of 104 people, were among those sent home.

item.title: Israelis war-weary but most oppose Iran ceasefire, poll suggests
item.summary: The vast majority did not believe Hezbollah or Iran had been severely weakened by weeks of Israeli and US attacks, according to the poll.

item.title: The US blockade of Iran is a gamble. Will it work?
item.summary: The US military is gambling on the blockade denying Iran vital trade - but questions remain on whether the bet will pay off.

item.title: Trump's blockade threat raises risks and leaves predicaments unchanged
item.summary: The conflict is now a test of wills - Iran’s capacity to absorb strikes versus Trump’s tolerance for the war's costs.

item.title: Ceasefire or no ceasefire, the Middle East's reshuffling is not yet done
item.summary: Both sides have reason to end the war but share no common ground.

item.title: 'Endless fears': Even if fighting stops, the damage to Iran's children will endure
item.summary: The BBC has been able to obtain testimony from parents and those trying to help children deal with the distress that comes with war.

item.title: What we know about the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
item.summary: A 10-day truce between the two countries is now in effect, with Iran-backed Hezbollah voicing support, as negotiations continue between the US and Iran.
